description: Source code for the 'Issue' doctype in ERPNext, including class definition, methods for issue management, communication handling, status updates, and SLA calculations.

classes.name: Issue
classes.description: Represents an issue/ticket in the support system, with methods for validation, communication, splitting, and metrics reset.

methods.name: get_feed
methods.description: Returns a formatted string with the issue's status and subject.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates and sets default values for a new issue, including lead contact assignment.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Creates a communication entry if flagged during update.

methods.name: set_lead_contact
methods.description: Sets lead, contact, customer, and company based on email address.

methods.name: create_communication
methods.description: Creates and saves a communication record linked to the issue.

methods.name: split_issue
methods.description: Splits the current issue into a new one, copying communications and resetting metrics.

methods.name: reset_issue_metrics
methods.description: Resets resolution and user resolution times.
